newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Mercator sees profit up, no dividend.
newsitem.headline: Mercator sees profit up, no dividend.

text.p: Slovenian trading company Mercator said on Thursday it expected a 1996 pre-tax profit of 670 million tolars ($4.6 million), up from 415.7 million in the previous year, but ruled out a dividend.

Mercator said management had proposed putting profit into the firm's reserves. The company, which listed on the over-the-counter (OTC) market of the Ljubljana bourse in April 1996, has never paid a dividend.
It said turnover rose around 3 percent last year from 3.3 billion tolars in 1995.
Mercator operates in domestic retail and wholesale markets, managing over 650 stores around Slovenia and a number of food processing companies. -- Marja Novak, Ljubljana newsroom, 386 61 1263 644
